title: New Acquisition: Fashion Forward: Avant-Garde Design
excerpt: New addition to the fashion collection: Fashion Forward: Avant-Garde Design.
content: We're pleased to announce the acquisition of "Fashion Forward: Avant-Garde Design" by Rei Kawakubo (Fashion Institute, 2023). This important work joins our fashion collection. Exploring radical approaches to fashion design and conceptual clothing. The book is now available for viewing by appointment.

title: Test Photography Book Added to Collection
excerpt: We've acquired Test Photography Book, A comprehensive look at contemporary street photography in urban environments..
content: We're pleased to announce the acquisition of "Test Photography Book" by Jane Photographer (Aperture, 2024). This important work joins our nyc collection. A comprehensive look at contemporary street photography in urban environments. The book is now available for viewing by appointment.

title: New Additions to Collage Collection
excerpt: We're excited to announce three significant additions to our collage collection, featuring works that explore the intersection of photography and assemblage.
content: We're excited to announce three significant additions to our collage collection. The Age of Collage series showcases contemporary artists pushing the boundaries of photographic collage, while works by Lotta Antonsson, Pacifico Silano, and Ray Johnson offer unique perspectives on this dynamic medium.

title: Poster Collection Now Online
excerpt: Browse our newly digitized collection of vintage concert posters, exhibition announcements, and graphic design ephemera.
content: Our poster and paper collection is now available to browse online. This collection includes rare concert posters featuring Bob Dylan and Richard Prince, exhibition posters from Jeff Wall and E. Payton shows, and the complete Permanent Paper series. Each piece has been professionally photographed and cataloged for research purposes.

title: Holiday Hours
excerpt: The library will maintain special hours during the holiday season. Please check our schedule before visiting.
content: Please note our special holiday hours: December 24-25: Closed. December 31: Open 10am-2pm. January 1: Closed. Regular hours resume January 2, 2025. Appointments can still be scheduled for research visits during this period.

title: Comme des Garçons: Six Magazine Archive
excerpt: Rare complete set of Comme des Garçons' Six magazine (1988-1991) now available for viewing.
content: Hudson Street Library has acquired a complete set of Comme des Garçons' influential Six magazine. Published between 1988 and 1991, these eight issues represent a crucial moment in fashion publishing, featuring photography by leading artists and Rei Kawakubo's radical vision for fashion communication. Available by appointment only.

title: New Ephemera Acquisitions
excerpt: Recent additions to our ephemera collection include artist postcards, exhibition invitations, and photography fair materials.
content: This month's ephemera acquisitions showcase the often-overlooked materials that document photography culture: exhibition announcements, artist postcards, gallery invitations, and fair catalogs. These materials provide crucial context for understanding how photography has been presented and circulated. Highlights include materials from 1970s SoHo galleries and contemporary photography fairs.

title: Website Launch
excerpt: Hudson Street Library's collection is now searchable online, with detailed information with our holdings and visit policies.
content: We're pleased to announce the launch of our new website, making Hudson Street Library's collection more accessible to researchers worldwide. The site features detailed collection information, high-resolution images, and an appointment booking system. We'll be adding new features and collections regularly.

title: Fashion Archive Reorganization Complete
excerpt: Comme des Garçons and Matsuda collections have been reorganized under our Fashion Archive for better discoverability.
content: We've completed a major reorganization of our fashion-related materials. The Comme des Garçons Six Magazine archive and Matsuda fashion catalogs from the 1990s are now organized under our Fashion Archive directory. This restructuring improves discoverability and creates a logical grouping for researchers interested in avant-garde Japanese fashion. All materials remain available by appointment, and the digital catalog has been updated to reflect the new organization.
